description.value: A family-run coffee institution that has been roasting beans for six generations, with its Vancouver flagship on Commercial Drive dating to 1979. The shop sources and roasts its own blends, sold in-café and by subscription, making it a neighbourhood anchor on one of Vancouver's most cycle-friendly streets. A second location operates on Main Street and a roasting plant operates in Burnaby.
